lines.cap: Cows aren't farting the planet to death. It's the burps.
lines.say: Cows aren't farting the planet to death. It's the burps.

lines.cap: Everyone blames cow farts for warming the planet.
lines.say: Everyone blames cow farts for warming the planet.

lines.cap: But inside a cow's first stomach, microbes break down grass, and make methane gas.
lines.say: But inside a cow's first stomach, microbes break down grass, and make methane gas.

lines.cap: Most of that gas comes out of the front. Around ninety five percent, by burping.
lines.say: Most of that gas comes out of the front. Around ninety five percent, by burping.

lines.cap: One cow can burp out around a hundred kilos of methane a year.
lines.say: One cow can burp out around a hundred kilos of methane a year.

lines.cap: And methane traps far more heat than carbon dioxide, at least for the first twenty years.
lines.say: And methane traps far more heat than carbon dioxide, at least for the first twenty years.

lines.cap: Scientists are testing fixes, like adding a little seaweed to cow feed, which cuts the burps.
lines.say: Scientists are testing fixes, like adding a little seaweed to cow feed, which cuts the burps.

lines.cap: So next time someone blames cow farts, tell them they've got the wrong end.
lines.say: So next time someone blames cow farts, tell them they've got the wrong end.
